cards.t: Bitwise launches US spot NEAR ETF amid token surge
cards.b: Bitwise has rolled out the first US spot NEAR ETF on NYSE Arca, providing direct brokerage access and staking rewards following a massive multi-month rally.

per.NEAR: Major structural tailwind from traditional financial product integration and surging volume.

cards.t: Cboe and S&P Dow Jones advance tokenized options roadmap
cards.b: An extended licensing agreement between Cboe and S&P Dow Jones lays the groundwork for tokenized derivatives, accelerating Wall Street's onchain migration of core index products.

per.ONDO: Positions institutional-grade tokenization infrastructure providers for increasing adoption.

cards.t: Aztec relaunches zk.money for private Ethereum payments
cards.b: Aztec Labs has brought back the zk.money self-custodial wallet, offering privacy-preserving stablecoin transactions via readable tags on the Aztec Network.

per.AZTEC: Revives privacy narrative on Ethereum L2s with direct user-facing tooling.

cards.t: Kakaopay teams up with Ondo and Dinari for tokenized Korean equities
cards.b: Kakaopay Securities is collaborating with Dinari and Ondo Finance to explore bringing tokenized Korean-listed stocks to international markets.

per.ONDO: Expands real-world asset tokenization footprint into Asian equity markets.

cards.t: Coinbase secures CFTC approval for in-house derivatives clearinghouse
cards.b: Coinbase has gained CFTC approval for its US derivatives clearinghouse, allowing the exchange to handle its entire derivatives stack and settle round-the-clock using USDC.

per.COIN: Strengthens institutional derivatives market positioning and integrated stablecoin utility.
